review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C bundle. Repository identity and base commit, REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, exact writable binding scopes, task keys, evidence stages, and assignment expectations agree with the original specification. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; ready with no decision blocker is therefore appropriate here. A materially unresolved DEC-001 in B must instead block at decisions, before later prerequisites. Source evidence supports the writable owners for message formatting, public/internal normalized types, runtime defaulting, and Ky-option filtering. The merge, index, options utility, hook types, and Ky instance types can remain inspection owners because their existing generic forwarding and declaration relationships support this change without mandatory edits. The build configuration establishes distribution declarations as generated outputs rather than separately maintained owners. The existing TypeScript compiler check includes test-d, allowing the proposed new type regression file without adding dependencies or confusing AVA/tsx execution with type checking. The separate implementer and verifier have active supplied trusted capability claims supporting the bounded scope, including data.change, domain.state, integration.consumer, TypeScript, contract, asynchronous integration, failure handling, and automation; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy claims and persona facts are not treated as trusted capability evidence. An independent configured reviewer is present for the earlier scenario-review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and whitespace-normalized saved PRD. Preparation-time null release/review fields and remaining-work notes do not contradict the subsequently supplied frozen release inputs. Isolation evidence states that Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle and supplies no historical candidate outputs. This approval concerns expectation coherence, not implementation or test success. I reviewed the supplied evidence without tools, code execution, independent digest recomputation, or creating any human attestation.
